sources.title: Macao Official Gazette, Chief Executive Notice 128/2015 and State Council Order 665
sources.role: Primary legal source for Macao SAR land and maritime administrative boundary and map
sources.vintage: Order approved 2015-12-16, effective 2015-12-20; Notice promulgated 2015-12-20 and revoked the 1999 map
sources.license: Reuse terms for Gazette map artwork and embedded cartographic base were not identified
sources.restoration: Restore HTML and PDF from these exact official URLs. HTML response: 25,879 bytes, SHA-256 e6a65f3081fe08254e3fd7fdbee51a7431962d8c373f6284e77fd72f9939956b. PDF response: 787,814 bytes, SHA-256 9b33be45094e18b30bacdaff9104cd3a12cf4701b2dbd15a5b7cd17361859426. Official PDF pages 2-3 (gazette pp. 18-19) visually inspected; do not redistribute map bytes absent rights review.
findings: The legal division has land and maritime components.
The order specifies an 85 km2 managed maritime area and a Border Gate land segment.
The official map shows the boundary extending offshore around the land areas; this visual inspection does not yield a reproducible polygon.
sources.limit: No lawful reusable official vector or coordinate reconstruction was obtained. A raster map and legal text cannot establish exact geometry/topology by visual inspection alone.

primary_research_limits: No original aggregate/import code or exact transformation recipe has been found; exact member ID joins are not geometry derivation proof.
No current licensed outer boundary vector for either SAR was retained.
No GIS union, overlay, topology, island-completeness, coastline-completeness, maritime-area or neighbor check was performed.
